title: Implement scoped and age-based handoff purging
description: Add provider and flat-file purge behavior over the atomic handoff collection. Support exactly one selector: canonical handoff ID, global scope, a resolved task UUID/short ID, or all scopes. Support an optional absolute cutoff supplied by the caller; delete records with createdAt strictly before it. Exact missing IDs must error, while an empty scope purge returns zero. Ensure scope-wide deletion without a cutoff removes every matching record, preserve nonmatching records, validate the rewritten collection, and return the purge count. CLI timestamp and duration parsing belongs to the CLI task.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Started implementation. The prerequisite handoff collection is present in the shared worktree; adding purge selector validation, atomic rewrite behavior, and focused provider tests.
